hanka_b97: The new rifleman gave his name as Bastian "Owl" Hanka. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Bastian "Owl" Hanka was number 2. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
A flare lit the Ossuary Wood like noon. Bastian "Owl" Hanka counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
Bastian "Owl" Hanka started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."

The relief reached S-F11 without Bastian "Owl" Hanka. His name was added to a list the corporal kept separate from the dead. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Bastian "Owl" Hanka stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Nobody at S-F11 has seen Bastian "Owl" Hanka since the last patrol. His bunk is still made.
maccerny808: Nobody saw Roland Maccerny arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-F4, and a quiet rifleman under it.
mng.ngaihte: The quartermaster asked Benedikt Ngaihte to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

A clear shot from R-F7. Benedikt Ngaihte grazed Jonas Steini and slid back down below the parapet. The report confirmed that the Concord held Verdel Ridge. Benedikt Ngaihte read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Benedikt Ngaihte kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
